info.name: Ark Investment API — Reviewer Demo
info.description: Run all seven folders in order with Ark Local Demo selected. See docs/GETTING_STARTED.md. Uses existing Keycloak accounts and actual database-backed roles. Dynamically discovers both Clients, captures generated IDs, verifies exact reports and denied access, and cleans its own financial records. No registration or invitation endpoint. No passwords, tokens, or Client IDs are committed. This is a local demo collection, not a load test. Run sequentially in one environment; do not run concurrent collection iterations.

item.name: Authentication and Current User
item.description: Run first. All seven demo users cover six roles. Passwords must be supplied locally; tokens are captured automatically. Authentication is the existing Keycloak token endpoint, never an API login endpoint. Tokens expire: rerun this folder to refresh them.

request.description: Local-demo password grant for public client; no client secret. Do not share token responses or export populated secrets.

exec: pm.environment.unset('alpha_admin_token');

if (!pm.environment.get('alpha_admin_password')) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Missing local alpha_admin_password. Import the private environment described in docs/GETTING_STARTED.md.'); }
pm.test('HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Unexpected status; stop and inspect this request. Captured IDs are retained for cleanup.'); }
const arkResponse=pm.response.json();

pm.test('Bearer access token issued', function () { pm.expect(arkResponse.token_type.toLowerCase()).to.eql('bearer'); pm.expect(typeof arkResponse.access_token).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(arkResponse.access_token.length > 20).to.eql(true); pm.expect(arkResponse.expires_in).to.be.above(0); });
pm.environment.set('alpha_admin_token',arkResponse.access_token);
pm.test('HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Unexpected status; stop and inspect this request. Captured IDs are retained for cleanup.'); }
const user=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('alpha_admin_user_id',user.id);

pm.test('Database role and ownership', function () { pm.expect(user.role).to.eql('CLIENT_ADMIN'); pm.expect(user.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(user.userType).to.eql('CLIENT'); pm.expect(user.clientId).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); });
pm.environment.set('alpha_client_id',user.clientId);

item.name: Financial Reports
item.description: Reports use string money values and ledger arithmetic, not NAV or performance returns. Read access is separate from financial management. Interval begins after the contribution to demonstrate opening balance.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Unexpected status; stop and inspect this request. Captured IDs are retained for cleanup.'); }
